headline: Mississippi’s state budget wheels go round and round
summary: Mississippi's $32 billion state budget for the next fiscal year is being developed, with the Joint Legislative Budget Committee hearing agency requests. The budget includes $13.11 billion in federal funds, with the general fund and state support funds totaling $9.22 billion. The Budget Committee and governor will develop a revenue estimate in the fall, with mid-year cuts possible if actual revenues fall short.

headline: Immigration insights: Tears and action follow ICE raids  in southwest Kansas
summary: ICE agents conducted raids in southwest Kansas, causing fear and uncertainty among Hispanic and Latino communities, with many families too scared to leave home. The operation led to protests, with locals demanding immigration reform and expressing concern for the well-being of immigrant families.
